item.title: ISL 2025-26: Mohun Bagan SG Comfortably Quell Kerala Blasters Challenge In Season Opener
item.description: Vivekananda Yuba Bharathi Krirangan: Defending champions Mohun Bagan Super scored once in each half as they started the Indian Super League (ISL) 2025-26 with a comfortable 2-0 victory over Kerala Blasters FC in the season opener at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharathi Krirangan (VYBK) inKolkata on Saturday.

item.title: T20 WC: West Indies Opt To Bowl Against Nepal, Forde Comes In For Shepherd
item.description: T20 World Cup: West Indies won the toss and elected to bowl against Nepal in their Group C game of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup at the iconic Wankhede Stadium on Sunday.

item.title: FIH Pro League: Belgium Beat India 4-2 In Rourkela Leg Rematch
item.description: Alexander Hendrickx scored twice as India went down to Belgium in the FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26 in Rourkela, marking their third straight defeat in the home leg.

item.title: Shelton Downs Shapovalov In SF Thriller, Sets Fritz Final In Dallas
item.description: Nexo Dallas Open: Ben Shelton survived a major test from fellow lefty Denis Shapovalov before prevailing in a final-set tiebreak to reach the Dallas Open final.

item.title: WTT Star Contender: Desai-Ghorpade Reach Mixed Doubles Final, Yokoi-Aoki Of Japan Claim Women’s Doubles Title (Ld)
item.description: WTT Star Contender Chennai: Fourth seeds Harmeet Desai and Yashaswini Ghorpade will carry India’s lone title hope after they eased into the mixed doubles final of the WTT Star Contender Chennai 2026 at the Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University in Chennai on Saturday.

item.title: T20 WC: 'You Can’t Be Unhappy With How SA Played': Shaun Pollock
item.description: T20 World Cup: Three matches into the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, South Africa have surged into strong contention for a Super 8 berth, registering their third consecutive win with a commanding victory over the New Zealand national cricket team in Ahmedabad, and former South Africa captain Shaun Pollock was full of praise for the manner in which the side imposed themselves on the contest.

item.title: ISL 2025-26: Debutants Inter Kashi Hold Super Cup Champions FC Goa To Earn First Point
item.description: Debutants Inter Kashi: Debutants Inter Kashi produced a disciplined and determined display to hold AIFF Super Cup champions FC Goa to a 1-1 draw in Match 2 of the Indian Super League (ISL) 2025-26 at the PJN Stadium in Fatorda, Goa, on Saturday.

item.title: T20 WC: 'He Doesn’t Need Any Special Advice...', Says Kuldeep's Childhood Coach Ahead Of Pakistan Clash
item.description: Kapil Dev Pandey: India spinner Kuldeep Yadav's childhood coach Kapil Dev Pandey lauded his ward's bowling prowess and stated that the left-arm wrist spinner doesn't need any special advice for the much-anticipated India-Pakistan clash in the T20 World Cup, as he has enough experience under his belt.

item.title: Liverpool, Man City And Newcastle Move Into Fifth Round Of FA Cup
item.description: West Bromwich Albion: Liverpool advanced to the fifth round of the FA Cup by defeating Brighton & Hove Albion 3-0 at Anfield.

item.title: Mahashivratri Prayers, Havan Held For India’s Victory Ahead Of T20 World Cup Clash With Pakistan
item.description: T20 World Cup: Ahead of the high-voltage T20 World Cup match between India and Pakistan, special prayers and rituals were performed at temples across the country on the occasion of Mahashivratri, with devotees seeking divine blessings for India’s victory.
